name: Sony MZ-1 MiniDisc recorder
summary: Sony's MZ-1 was an early portable recorder for MiniDisc, a small rewritable digital audio disc that let listeners record and jump between tracks instantly.
description: Sony MiniDisc portable digital audio format using a recordable magneto-optical disc, ATRAC compression and rapid track access; Sony MZ-1 was an early marketed recorder.

evidence.supports: Sony identifies the MZ-1, MZ-2P and recordable discs as Japan market products in November 1992.
